privacy.summary: How Gridsmith Ltd collects and uses personal data through this website, enquiries, optional analytics and client work: who receives it, where, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.changes: Provider names replaced by recipient categories where categories are accurate; hosting country reduced to the European Economic Area; transfer destinations kept where safeguards depend on them (Pakistan; the United States, with UK adequacy only for certified organisations); Freelancer platform records distinguished from the working copies Gridsmith needs; Freelancer review copies described with their contents and current public locations; freelancing platforms added as recipients; optional Google Analytics 4 and PostHog described as conditional on being offered, with data, settings, retention, withdrawal and transfers; cookie choices not recorded by Gridsmith; cross-reference links.

cookies.summary: The cookie that records your choice, and the optional Google Analytics 4 and PostHog analytics that run only if you allow them, with how to change your mind at any time.
cookies.changes: Optional Google Analytics 4 and PostHog with per-service choices; cookie and browser-storage table as measured with the real libraries; a 180-day choice whose analytics identifiers expire with it; page views only, sent without query or fragment; withdrawal across open pages and re-consent; notice mode described for builds offering no analytics; content management provider named by category; cross-reference links.

client-terms.summary: Which client terms apply depends on the purpose of your purchase, including whether an individual is buying wholly or mainly outside a trade, business, craft or profession. Your quotation identifies the applicable version.
client-terms.changes: Cross-reference links only. Served words unchanged.

business-client-terms.summary: The terms for paid work for businesses and anyone buying for a trade, business, craft or profession. Each project is defined by a written Scope that is accepted before any payment is requested.
business-client-terms.changes: Cross-reference links only. Served words unchanged.

consumer-client-terms.summary: The terms for paid work for individuals buying outside a trade, business, craft or profession: how a quotation is accepted, your 14-day right to cancel, and what you pay if a project ends early. Consumer law gives you rights these terms cannot take away.
consumer-client-terms.changes: Cross-reference links only. Served words unchanged. The cancellation form is byte-identical; the consumer workflow is re-labelled 3.5.

accessibility.summary: How accessible gridsmith.uk is, the WCAG 2.2 AA testing carried out, the known limitations and manual checks outstanding, and how to ask for help or an alternative format.
